slices.focus: After Priya accepts a Boston job, Hannah chooses a smaller solo apartment over a roommate search
slices.summary: After Priya (her roommate since grad school) gets a Boston development job, Hannah moves to a smaller solo Providence apartment — consciously choosing quiet, control, and less clutter over cheaper shared space with a stranger.
open_loops: Set hard work-box boundary immediately (one zone, hard capacity limit)
Finish kitchen setup (good lighting, sleep setup, one frictionless cooking station)
Text Priya a first Boston date idea before move logistics swallow it
Allow sadness without turning it into evidence of wrong choice
decisions: After Priya accepted a stronger development job in Boston and planned to move at the end of the summer, Hannah moved out
